workspace.title: LeadFlow Workspace
workspace.tagline: Turn public Instagram lists into reviewable leads.
workspace.sourcePlaceholder: Open an Instagram profile, then paste its URL or username
workspace.notice: LeadFlow requests public list data directly from this browser’s existing Instagram session. Enter a public profile URL or username. If Instagram slows or blocks access, collection pauses rather than retrying aggressively.
workspace.name: Name
workspace.clearConfirm: Remove the current local task and its records?
workspace.noExport: There are no local records to export yet.

reason.invalidSource: Enter a public Instagram username or profile URL.
reason.profileControlMissing: Could not find the {listType} control on this profile page.
reason.dialogMissing: Instagram did not open the list dialog. Refresh the profile and try again.
reason.dialogClosed: Instagram list dialog was closed. Collection interrupted; reopen it and start a new task.
reason.noProfiles: No new visible profiles were loaded; the list may be complete or unavailable.
reason.sessionRejected: Instagram rejected the current session. Sign in again, then retry.
reason.rateLimited: Instagram rate-limited this browser session. Collection has paused.
reason.profileIdMissing: Could not determine the numeric Instagram profile ID from this public profile page.
reason.listUnavailable: Instagram returned no accessible list data. The account may be private, restricted, or its web format changed.

pricing.title: LeadFlow plans
pricing.description: Pricing is shown in the extension before any paid capability is enabled. Checkout is not enabled in this MVP.
pricing.freeDescription: Small local collections, CSV/JSON export and local history.
pricing.proDescription: Higher limits, detailed public profiles, XLSX and saved projects.
pricing.teamDescription: Shared projects, CRM export and cross-platform lead workflows.
